summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity facility of up to $50 million of common stock with Virtu Americas LLC as agent. The company may sell shares at prevailing market prices; on June 17, 2026, the stock closed at $3.29 per share on Nasdaq. Virtu receives a 3% commission. No escrow or trust arrangement is involved. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. What to watch: sales pace and dilution; no risk-arb angle as it is a capital markets transaction.
